actual_file_scope: Entire 425-line actual candidate freshly reread in two untruncated parts, including both full proofs and the scope remark. checks: Affine-curve H2 vanishing gives same-field GL lifts. For a fixed local projective class, lifted conjugation and scalar Kummer characters give at most q-1 local linear classes. The scalar splitting extension is tame and contributes at most one to normalized different by the exact tower formula.

The varying inverse divisor B=sum c_x x gives the stated cyclic slope window by actual forward and dual inverse injections, without tensor semistability. The explicitly chosen H degree is O_p(1+g+sum c_x+|P|).

The r+1 generator quotient and fixed seven-term/two-section continuation have the exact alternating line syzygies. Their rank conditions are actual all-ring unit-minor conditions; separated source/target lengths and the top-generator identity test retain exact Hom and inverse equations.

All line cohomology dimensions are bounded by 2g+2+|degree|. The top-top, mixed and lower Hom blocks give O_p(A r^2) per phase. The fixed-width perturbation formulas have degree bounded solely by p; no q-fold expanded word or moving Picard basis is introduced.

The individual N_x and L_x satisfy strict integral contraction and have sum O_p(sum c_x+|P|). Quotient-frame and restriction witnesses have O_p(f A r^2) coordinates. Fixed complete local types, rather than merely a different bound, give actual integral specified-Artinian Isom lifting and open class images.
The component-count prefactor and all scalar local-lift choices are explicitly absorbed into the claimed universal c_p exponent.

The original detecting curve pulls back to one connected degree-t curve with fundamental group surjecting onto H. A normal core in Gamma simultaneously trivializes any H representation and the coset cover.

Different transitivity gives both delta_y<=e_y(b_x+1) and the exact residual budget d_y=e_y(b_x+1)-delta_y. Wild Riemann-Hurwitz bounds genus and marked points by O(t), while the sum of all d_y and local testing lengths is O(t).

Every fixed original completed-local source has connected cover factors whose degrees sum to t. Applying the local hereditary projective theorem to each factor costs q^{O(t r^2)}; each source factor is counted once even when it supplies several curve branches. No injectivity of local fundamental groups is assumed.

Restriction along the detecting surjection is injective on conjugacy classes. Extra retained smooth points supply trivial local representations. Global geometric period and gcd(r,q-1) are valid sufficient conditions, not additional unproved uniformity assertions.
